# Type Clock (`typeClock`)

The time, set huge in SF Pro or New York, lit by a light that follows the sun.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: clock
- Cost: medium (~5.0 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Glass Clock, Plaster Clock

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | Style | menu | 0 Relief · 1 Glass · 2 Ink | 0 (Relief) |
| `face` | Typeface | menu | 0 Sans · 1 Serif · 2 Rounded | 0 (Sans) |
| `weight` | Weight | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
| `size` | Size | slider | 0.5 … 1.3 | 1 |
| `h24` | 24-Hour | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `seconds` | Seconds | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `date` | Date | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |
| `depth` | Depth | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
